% The abstract of every paper in this folder.
\begin{abstract}
Merge conflicts interrupt the work of developers and delay the integration of changes. This paper predicts the
files of a pull request that will conflict from the build history of the project and the distance between the
changes. On 1,840 pull requests of twelve projects, the predictor finds 412 of 503 conflicting files (81.9\%).
\end{abstract}
